prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic premium MOVERNO footwear concept master product photograph, not a poster, not a collage. This is a new original youth-fashion shoe, not an edit or rebranding of the reference product. Background seamless very light neutral grey (#f4f3f0), soft grounded contact shadow, sophisticated large softbox with a fine directional highlight revealing texture, accurate proportions, restrained contemporary Japanese/Korean fashion e-commerce art direction. Single shoe, fully visible, three-quarter front/outside view, toe pointing toward lower-left and heel toward upper-right, camera mildly above shoe so instep opening and lateral surface are clear. Horizontal 3:2 composition, product occupying about 80% of width, no props, feet, people, scenery or decorative typography. Quiet dark luxury, unmistakably youthful. Branding inputs are immutable originals: opposing two upright curved blades separated by a narrow open vertical slit; do not make a butterfly, X, literal M, three stripes, swoosh or third-party logo. 'MOVERNO' spelled exactly M O V E R N O, only on specified shoe location. No unsupported performance text, no slogans, no product labels outside shoe. Avoid chunky dad runners, medical shoes, comfort-walking styling, office pumps, heavy platforms, cage structures, large rear sole extensions and large blank side plaques. Input 1 is ONLY a low-profile sport-ballet proportion reference; do NOT reuse its side stripe, two elastic bars, toe logo or exact panels. Input 2 is the exact MOVERNO emblem; input 3 is exact wordmark; input 4 is the repeat pattern geometry ONLY, not its gold/red colors. SUBJECT F01: slender but wearable ALMOND toe, thin low slightly wedge-free continuous black rubber outsole with a distinct tiny rounded lip, matte fine-grain black leather upper. An asymmetric slanted instep opening with a subtly higher inner quarter and lower outside waist, ONE narrow diagonal leather instep strap connecting into the outer quarter, NOT two straps or an X. Strap is elegant yet athletic, about 12 mm visually, an understated hidden stud fastening and one tiny smoke-silver exact double-blade emblem at its outer attachment. Closed soft low heel, snug smooth collar without inflated padding, no laces, no heel pull loop, no toe cap panel. On a small patch at outer waist, blind-emboss just TWO small full repeat units using input4 geometry, black-on-black extremely restrained, not the whole side. The shoe must read as a refined sport Mary Jane for a young creative wardrobe, not a formal pump or granny shoe. Small MOVERNO wordmark on insole only. Show the side waist and the slant of the strap clearly.
